title: Fact-Checking Tool — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Checks claims against reliable evidence and shows the verdict. The Fact-Checking Tool checks claims against reliable evidence. It breaks a claim into checkable parts, searches trusted sources for each part, and returns a verdict — supported, disputed, or unsupported — with the evidence cited. When sources disagree, it shows both sides instead of picking one silently.
capabilities: Break claims into checkable parts
Search trusted sources for each part
Return supported/disputed/unsupported verdicts
Cite the evidence for each verdict
Show both sides when sources disagree

demo.title: Core operation executed
demo.code: const docs=[{id:1,text:'spaced repetition improves recall'},{id:2,text:'massed practice is weaker'},{id:3,text:'sleep aids memory'}];const hits=docs.filter(d=>d.text.includes('repetition')).map(d=>d.id);J({hits});assert(JSON.stringify(hits)==='[1]','search');

demo.title: Worked example end to end
demo.code: const paras=['Sleep consolidates memory.','REM sleep aids procedural learning.','Naps improve afternoon recall.'];const brief=paras.map(p=>p.split('.')[0]+'.');J({sentences:brief.length,first:brief[0]});assert(brief.length===3&&brief[0]==='Sleep consolidates memory.','summarize');
